// diagnostic

L0208

`{member}` keeps a broken escape as written and turns invalid UTF-8 into U+FFFD.

What

`{member}` keeps a broken escape as written and turns invalid UTF-8 into U+FFFD.

Why

The tolerant decoder follows the browser standard, so two different inputs can decode to the same value; code that picks a file or an account from that value must refuse bad input instead.

Fix

If the value names a file or an account, call `{member}_strict` and handle its `FormDecodeError`; otherwise keep this call. `jet fix --all` writes the strict call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0208: tests/ui_lint/tolerant_form_decode.warn.

Warning [jet.TolerantFormDecode]: `form_decode` keeps a broken escape as written and turns invalid UTF-8 into U+FFFD.
  --> tests/ui_lint/tolerant_form_decode.jet:7:51
    |
  7 | city: fn(body: String) -> String { query_get(http.form_decode(body), "city") ?? "" }
    |                                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The tolerant decoder follows the browser standard, so two different inputs can decode to the same value; code that picks a file or an account from that value must refuse bad input instead.
 Fix: If the value names a file or an account, call `form_decode_strict` and handle its `FormDecodeError`; otherwise keep this call. `jet fix --all` writes the strict call.
